samples.answer: A Bucket Wheel Excavator (BWE) is a continuous mining machine that excavates material using a rotating wheel fitted with buckets. It is mainly used in large open-cast mines for continuous excavation of overburden, lignite, coal, soft rock, and other relatively unconsolidated materials. BWEs are particularly suitable for large-scale, continuous open-cast mining operations with relatively uniform and soft-to-medium-strength formations.
